FR-001.title: Product search field offers an "Advanced search" affordance in both hosting surfaces

FR-002.title: Affordance hidden, and the screen route-gated, without catalog read access

FR-003.title: Affordance unavailable whenever the search field itself is disabled

FR-004.title: Text already typed in the field carries over as the screen's initial search term

FR-005.title: Opening the screen alters nothing on the sale until a selection is confirmed

FR-006.title: Own addressable screen carrying search/filters/page; returning lands back on the unchanged sale

FR-007.title: Columns are photo, code, name, brand, unit plus a leading selection control - no status, no row actions

FR-008.title: Only active and salable products listed; no status or salable control in the filter panel

FR-009.title: Same search box and badged filters button; panel offers Stockable, Purchasable, Supplier, Label and clear-all

FR-010.title: Filters badge counts by the catalog list's rule, each label individually

FR-011.title: Paged with the catalog list's page size; returns to the first page on search or filter change

FR-012.title: Row tap toggles selection and never opens the product's catalog record

FR-013.title: Loading, empty and error states consistent with the catalog list, with retry and clear-filters

FR-014.title: Usable at a narrow window with confirm and cancel reachable and the count unobscured

FR-015.title: Selection permits one or many products according to the deployment's selection mode

FR-016.title: Single-selection mode releases the previously selected product

FR-017.title: Multiple selection survives paging/search/filter changes, shows a count, and can be cleared

FR-018.title: Explicit confirm required; cancel returns having added nothing

FR-019.title: One line per selected product, in selection order, with the scan path's starting quantity

FR-020.title: Every selected product priced for the sale's customer and warehouse before its line is created

FR-021.title: A product that cannot be priced is reported and skipped without blocking the rest

FR-022.title: Confirm protected against repeat submission; no duplicate lines on double-confirm or navigation

FR-023.title: Confirming opens the sale when none is open yet, as the scan path already does

FR-024.title: Selection mode is a build-time deployment option, never UI-mutable, never per-user

FR-025.title: Option documented with a default in the configuration template; malformed values fall back

FR-026.title: New strings localized in Spanish and English; values use the app's established formatting

context: area: lib/features/sales/presentation/capture/product_search_field.dart (the widget being improved, and its two hosts capture_step.dart / orders/order_screen.dart)
area: lib/features/catalog/presentation/products_list_screen.dart + core/widgets (CatalogFilterBar, CatalogSearchBar, CatalogFilterSheet, DataTableView) — the pattern the new screen mirrors
area: lib/core/config/app_settings.dart + .env.template — where the new deployment-level selection-mode option lands (spec 027 FR-001..FR-007)

constraint: no mbe-api change — GET /sales-orders/product-lookup takes pattern/customer/warehouse only, no paging and no facets, so the table must be backed by the catalog listing and pricing resolved per selection at confirm time
constraint: /products is route-gated by PrivilegeGate(SystemObject.products, AccessRight.read) and the server enforces the same, so the affordance must be access-gated rather than lead to a 403
intent: Let an operator browse the catalog from inside a sale — a paged, filterable products table opened from the product search field — and bring one or several products back as sale lines.
expectations: No mbe-api change: the sales-order product lookup endpoint stays as it is
No change to the existing scan / type-ahead behaviour of the product search field
No price editing from the advanced search screen
No status column and no per-row action icons on the advanced search table
Selection mode is not a per-user preference and is never changeable from the UI
No select-all control and no cap on selection size

decisions.decision: Screen is a top-level pushed route /sales/product-search; every in-screen navigation uses GoRouter.replace, never context.go (go would unmount the sale beneath and dispose the autoDispose sale controller)

Selection returns via two plain StateProviders consumed by ProductSearchField with ref.listen; the screen cannot add lines itself because OrderScreen overrides saleEditorProvider in a nested ProviderScope
ProductSearchField.onProductSelected becomes Future<void> Function(ProductLookupResult) so adds are sequential (ensureOpen is not concurrency-safe) and per-product failures can be reported
Checkbox cell is non-interactive (IgnorePointer); the row tap is the only toggle, avoiding two tap handlers on the same pixels; DataTableView is not modified
active+salable are forced inside ProductFilter so productLabelFacets counts match the listing; the screen computes its own filter badge instead of ProductFilterBadge.activeFilterCount
New app setting PRODUCT_SEARCH_MULTI_SELECT (String.fromEnvironment + Dart-side parse, default true)

Analyze remediation: tasks.md renumbered to 48 tasks — added T021 (list states), T022 (double-confirm guard), T023 (lazy sale open), T024 (order-screen host), T037 (10-product batch); MVP checkpoint reworded with US2 as the release floor per constitution VI

Fixed a pre-existing bug found via T024's test: productLookupController had no Riverpod dependencies:[saleEditor], so it always resolved saleEditorProvider against the ROOT container regardless of OrderScreen's nested override — meaning a scan/lookup on an existing order silently opened a phantom register sale instead of adding to the order. Added @Riverpod(dependencies:[saleEditor]) and regenerated codegen. Verified via a minimal repro (fails before, passes after) and confirmed no regression across 1840 unit/widget/golden tests. User approved fixing this in-branch rather than deferring it.

verified.what: MBE_POS_* is an administrator account, so no dev-tenant account can prove whether cashiers hold products.read (test/integration/TEST_ACCOUNTS.md) — spec Assumption 8 closed as unverifiable and safe either way
_routeGate matches only /sales/cash-sessions, /sales/pos and /sales/orders — /sales/product-search would be ungated without a new clause
GET /sales-orders/product-lookup takes pattern/customer/warehouse only, no paging or facets and no documented result cap

concerns.note: DataColumn2 mis-sizes consecutive fixed-width columns (privileges_grid.dart:98-102); the checkbox column makes three in a row on this table — assert alignment in a widget test

GoRouter.replace reusing the page key is what preserves the screen State across filter changes; if it does not hold in the browser, fall back to a Navigator.push full-screen route with local view state (customer_inline_create.dart pattern)
